name: Sarah
description: The blacksmith's wife, who once baked Mia cookies for her birthday and calls for her to be sacrificed.

timeline.summary: Villagers, led by Sarah, turn on Mia and demand she be sacrificed to the Gitrog.
timeline.quote: Kill her! A sacrifice to the Gitrog!
